Two days ago, my friend and I discovered one of Istanbul’s newest and most fascinating places: Tersane Istanbul. I had actually been there once before for an event during my previous job, but at that time I did not have the chance to explore it properly. I had told my friend about the atmosphere of the place, and finally we were able to go together. It turned into one of those unexpected Istanbul days that feels calm, elegant, and almost unreal.
